name: A Great Barrington woodland lot

place_source.title: Wikidata: Great Barrington, Massachusetts (Q1144518), coordinate location and elevation above sea level

blurb: A woodland lot in the Berkshire hills near Great Barrington: sugar maple, oak and hemlock around a rural plot, with chickadees, blue jays and wild turkeys by day and foxes, a barred owl and big brown bats after dark.

facts.text: Great Barrington is a town in Berkshire County, Massachusetts, set in the Berkshire hills along the Housatonic River.

source.title: Wikipedia: Great Barrington, Massachusetts
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Great Barrington, Massachusetts", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: The town has a humid continental climate (Köppen Dfb), with cold winters and warm summers.

source.title: Beck et al. 2018, Köppen-Geiger climate classification map
source.attribution: Beck, H. E. et al. (2018), Present and future Köppen-Geiger climate classification maps, CC BY 4.0

facts.text: Great Barrington is a rural, wooded resort town, long a summer retreat and now also home to a ski area on the surrounding hills.

source.title: Wikipedia: Great Barrington, Massachusetts
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Great Barrington, Massachusetts", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: The Berkshire hills are noted for their northern hardwood forest of sugar maple, American beech and yellow birch.

source.title: Wikipedia: Berkshires
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Berkshires", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0
